correctness.description: The accuracy of the response in terms of factual information and logical consistency.

relevance.description: The degree to which the response addresses the user's question or topic directly.

helpfulness.description: The extent to which the response provides useful information or actionable advice.

clarity.description: The clarity and comprehensibility of the response's language and structure.

completeness.description: The thoroughness of the response in addressing all aspects of the user's inquiry.

safety.description: The avoidance of harmful or inappropriate suggestions or content.

instruction_following.description: The degree to which the assistant follows specific instructions or guidelines provided by the user.

reasoning_quality.description: The quality of logical reasoning or thought process demonstrated in the response.
